study.name: Phase 2c Exploratory: Pure-Positive HP Scaling
study.description:
Exploratory follow-up to Phase 2c (H8). Tests whether adding hard
positives to a pure-positive library (no Canon-) yields further
improvement over plus-hp (F1=0.609, the Phase 2c winner).

Three conditions test HP scaling in a negative-free context:
  - pure-positive-canon: 4 Canon+ only (baseline, reused from Phase 2c)
  - pure-positive-2hp: 4 Canon+ + 2 HP (one Rakovski, one Elenovo)
  - pure-positive-4hp: 4 Canon+ + 4 HP (all available hard positives)

The pure-positive-canon condition (10 runs) can be copied from the
main Phase 2c output directory to avoid redundant API calls.
